text: For 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31, using UK as United Kingdom and “units sold” as units_sold, the top 5 showrooms were Kestrel Birmingham East with 1107, Kestrel Liverpool South with 983, Kestrel Manchester Riverside with 913, Kestrel Leicester Lakeside with 746, and Kestrel London City Centre with 742.
